summary: refactor(shared): move legacy db config, transformers and mysql to a lib
description:
Because:

- The legacy MySQL config, transformers and mysql helpers sit in fxa-shared, and other packages import them through package paths.

This commit:

- Adds the lib @fxa/shared/db/mysql/legacy (shared-db-mysql-legacy, ts-jest).
- Moves db/mysql.ts and db/transformers.ts into the lib, and copies db/config.ts.
- Changes the auth-server, admin-server and fxa-shared importers to the alias.
- Ports the transformers mocha test to jest.
- Removes the ./db/mysql exports entry from fxa-shared.

Closes FXA-10654
